product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides an AI-powered enterprise solution that helps public and private companies, asset managers, governments, institutions, and family offices make decisions and get answers.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer lists products, clients, company, blog, FAQ, and legal pages, but no pricing page.

employee_band.notes: Reported headcounts differ, but both cited counts fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The index is primarily industry and product thought leadership; it does not show two engineering posts about how Haptiq's product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public site links a general FAQ and legal materials, but no product documentation site or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page linked by Haptiq shows an empty current-opportunities list and says no jobs were found.

model_provider.notes: The public product FAQ, blog, privacy policy, and DPA do not identify a model provider; the DPA says its subprocessor list is available upon request.

compliance_certs.notes: Haptiq's public privacy/security disclosure describes safeguards but does not claim any of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a 2022-04-27 Buyout/LBO as the latest financing; Preqin describes Pearl Street Equity's April 2022 investment as undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed financing was in April 2022, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Haptiq's current careers ATS shows no open roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 28, 2026 product update announced new Orion connectors and new Olympus compliance-engine features, within the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bhuvan Khanna's profile marks his Haptiq GM/Chief Product Officer role as ending in May 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Haptiq sales/GTM job post names Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM platform examples in its qualifications; this is a job-post signal rather than a definitive deployed-system inventory.
